rules.brand_authority: The OIKOS workbook owns brand identity and asset rules. Framework defaults never override it.
rules.assignment: Every output resolves a brand ID, one integrity layer L1-L7 and one asset template A/B/C.
rules.colour: Use the shared navy, white and slate base. Layer colours are accents, not standalone palettes.
rules.framework: Astryx is a React component implementation source only where React is appropriate.
rules.adapters: All formats consume the same semantic tokens through target-native adapters.

templates.name: Corporate / Commercial
templates.use: Foundations, assurance, market entry and executive-facing offers

templates.name: Human / Outcome
templates.use: People, family, learning, support and capability

templates.name: Signal / Agent / Internal
templates.use: Signals, agents, research, internal and technical systems

typography.note: Legacy visual boards are reference inputs. Font families, licences, fallbacks, weights and icon rules still require reconciliation.

astryx.note: Verify current exports, theme extension API, accessibility and package compatibility before production binding.
